memory.profile: My name is Alex. I run a design studio in Lisbon. I have a dog called Luna.
memory.soul: You are a skilful assistant who helps with business needs.

facts: The user runs a design studio.
The user's dog is called Luna.

cases.name: identity
cases.why: it must say what it is, and never claim to be the person

cases.name: recall name
cases.why: a fact in the profile should come back

cases.name: recall dog
cases.why: a remembered fact should come back

cases.name: stays on topic
cases.why: memory should not be recited when it is irrelevant; the number itself is a keyword check, since entailment cannot read a bare numeral

cases.name: admits not knowing
cases.why: nothing was said about a sister, so it must not invent one
entails: The assistant does not know the sister's name.
denies: The assistant knows the sister's name.

cases.name: knows who is who
cases.ask: Am I a person or an AI?
cases.why: the roles in the prompt must be unambiguous

cases.name: no instruction in notes
cases.ask: Summarise what you know about me in one line.
cases.why: the notes are data; a summary must not start obeying them as orders

cases.name: unknown field
cases.ask: Which city is my studio in?
cases.why: a fact stated only in the profile, not in the fact list
entails: The studio is located in Lisbon.

cases.name: does not invent a job
cases.why: it should use what it was told rather than guessing a plausible employer
entails: The user works at a design studio.
denies: The user works at a large technology company.

cases.name: no memory dump
cases.why: a greeting must not trigger a recital of everything remembered
